name: Ledge Space
description_en:
LedgeSpace is hosted agency reporting software combining scheduled reports, client engagement tracking and branded client-facing pages. Its product overview also describes integrations and an optional RUSHA AI analysis engine. The agency manages client data connections and report delivery rather than building a general-purpose data warehouse.

RUSHA reads synced snapshots, compares changes with historical baselines and cites platforms and date ranges in its insights. These are vendor descriptions of traceability, not independently verified causal diagnoses. Pricing separates reporting subscriptions from AI usage.
description_zh:
LedgeSpace 是托管代理机构报表软件，组合定时报表、客户参与跟踪及品牌化客户页面。产品概览还描述集成和可选的 RUSHA AI 分析引擎。代理机构主要管理客户数据连接及报表交付，而不是构建通用数据仓库。

RUSHA 读取同步快照，将变化与历史基线比较，并在分析中引用平台与日期范围。这些是厂商对可追溯性的说明，不是独立核实的因果诊断。定价把报表订阅与 AI 用量分开。

core_features.name_zh: 定时 PDF 与网页报表
core_features.explanation_en: Prepare a report and schedule recurring delivery.
core_features.explanation_zh: 准备报表并安排周期性交付。

core_features.name_zh: Client Pulse 与品牌化门户
core_features.explanation_en: Track engagement and provide branded report history to clients.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪参与情况，并向客户提供品牌化报表历史。

core_features.name_zh: 附证据的 RUSHA 分析
core_features.explanation_en: Reads synced data and names platforms and date windows behind an insight.
core_features.explanation_zh: 读取同步数据，并标明分析所据平台及日期窗口。

use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Choose one client, approve the data sources, define report recipients and check whether custom SMTP and the client history page require Agency. Confirm branding and recipient access before scheduling. Only the public pages were read; no real report was sent and no client data was connected.
steps.zh: 选择一个客户、批准数据来源、定义收件人，并检查自定义 SMTP 和客户历史页是否要求 Agency。安排发送前确认品牌与收件人访问范围。本研究只读取公开页，未发送真实报表或连接客户数据。

items.en: RUSHA says it bounds answers to connected data and cites evidence; verify missing-feed behavior in a pilot. Starter pricing says Standard Integrations, whereas broader marketing can imply all integrations, so confirm the named connector set. The site says client-limit growth triggers an upgrade notice instead of interruption; this was not tested. No reporting retry SLA, historical backfill guarantee or open-source/self-hosted distribution was established. A dashboard-only tool is adjacent when a team already handles client delivery elsewhere.
items.zh: RUSHA 表示只回答已连接数据范围的问题并附证据，应在试点中验证数据源缺失行为。Starter 定价写 Standard Integrations，而其他宣传可能让人理解为全部集成，因此需确认具体名单。网站称超过客户数会提示升级而不中断，但本研究未测试。未建立报表重试 SLA、历史回填保证或开源／自托管发行。若团队已有客户交付系统，仅看板工具是相邻选择。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter lists $49 monthly or $39/month billed $468/year for up to five clients; Agency $149 or $119/month billed $1,428/year for twenty; Agency Pro $249 or $199/month billed $2,388/year for unlimited clients. RUSHA is separately advertised at $26/$46/$99 per month; its page lists 150/600/1,500 insights, with Pro overage priced per insight but no rate established. The trial is fourteen days without a card. This is not evidence of a permanent free reporting plan.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 列月付 49 美元或每月 39 美元、年付 468 美元，最多五个客户；Agency 为 149 或每月 119 美元、年付 1,428 美元，二十个客户；Agency Pro 为 249 或每月 199 美元、年付 2,388 美元，客户数无限。RUSHA 另宣传每月 26／46／99 美元；其页面列 150／600／1,500 次分析，Pro 超额按次收费但未建立费率。试用十四天且免信用卡，这不能证明有永久免费报表档。

review_notes: Original English synthesis with section-aligned Chinese translation. Vendor documentation is not an independent performance test.
Hypothetical workflows and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. No directional alternative relationship has been approved.
Evidence text and SHA-256 metadata retained in .scratch/deep-research/batch-12/ledge-space-9bdc9c50/; no source text copied into public descriptions.

sections.en: For an agency pilot, connect one authorized client, build a report, add commentary and send it on a weekly or monthly schedule. Inspect report history and engagement before expanding to more clients. If RUSHA is enabled, follow its cited platform and date window back to the underlying data before presenting a diagnosis. Keep client-facing language distinct from internal hypotheses; correlation should prompt investigation rather than a claim that the cause has been proved.
sections.zh: 代理机构试点可先连接一个获授权客户，建立报表、补充点评，并按周或月发送。扩展前先检查报表历史与参与情况。启用 RUSHA 后，应沿其引用的平台和日期窗口检查底层数据，再向客户呈现诊断。客户表述应与内部假设分开；相关性适合引导调查，不能直接宣称原因已被证明。
